title: [WA] Free Tickets for Juventus Vs Inter Milan, Saturday 8 August 7:00 PM at Optus Stadium @ Ticketmaster
body:
Deal: [WA] Free Tickets for Juventus Vs Inter Milan, Saturday 8 August 7:00 PM at Optus Stadium @ Ticketmaster

[Checkmate3023] Thats pretty amazing if i was in WA id go down for a bit
No idea the lines up, either team have here but they two big clubs its worth heading to the event
[Bearlion] Inter only without Thuram and Lautaro, theyre close to full squad.
[Checkmate3023] Its pretty good i mean for a free event
I honestly would pay to see this and im not even a Serie A fan
Amazing they couldn't pull a decent crowd
[QuickToThePointless] Italians have already seen enough of their national heroes lately at the World Cup…oh wait a minute
[TheWetArmpit] Out of curiosity, have you ever watched a movie/tv show?
[Checkmate3023] I’m sorry, but I know I’m probably going to be unpopular for saying this… 😂 I genuinely have no idea what’s so entertaining about watching 22 adults running around chasing a ball! I guess as long as people are willing to pay good money to watch it, it must be worth it. Personally, I’d rather spend my time doing something a little more controllable—where I actually have some say in the outcome! 😂
i dont have any interest in death metal or knitting or taking speed or smoking or watching chick flicks etc but i appericate other people enjoy it they get a thrill or enjoyment out of it. Thus, to be technical it releases endorphins in ones brain that provides thats a feeling of happiness or satisfaction sport like other entertainment does the same thing.
the very idea 'you' dont enjoy but you cant understand why other do i actually find very strange you're either having a medical episode or are just ultra-self centered but either way there must be a lot of things that confuse you
[D grump] I wonder what was the initial financial construction for this event? (Off topic, sorry. Should ve put that into Financial forum)
[spackbace] It's also cold and rainy in Perth today 😛
[CheapGit] Cold enough to cover my lawn in hailstones! Plus chuck in the heavy rain and thunder which has just gone past.
[Combo64] The same crappy system that offered the free AO tickets no one ever got.
Not fooling anyone this time
[Frackingiscool] I'm in Perth and also wish this was in Sydney
[Chris87] You guys can take our afl teams and we'll take this and sell it out as a fare trade
[QuickToThePointless] i prefer to stay home warm and dry and watch the wallabies
[churlish] Yes me too most nights, but it's a free ticket to a packed stadium event so I'll take it.
[QuickToThePointless] good luck mate - hope you dont get frostbitten fingers and/or hailstones in your eyes!
[supaconan] I think the problem is the opposite - Having coached 10+ years here from juniors to Vets, I can tell you WA is mad for soccer.
The problem is that they had advertised these tickets for $150+ a seat when it first opened.
That's mad pricing - I know people who spent $600+ to go to the Inter-Milan game (Family of 4)
Then to find people sitting in the same section who got the $39 tickets for the exact same event, as they always do this.
This is Ticketmaster standard behaviour btw - Same happens with Rugby league and union - to the point that people now wait as they know it won't fill up.
[QuickToThePointless] now the $39 punters will find people sitting in the same section who got free tickets for the exact same event!
[Skinnerr] I blame Infantino for this and for that reason, I won't be attending in protest.
[pauly85] I see this as a good thing.
Ticketmaster rip everyone off by pushing the prices as high as people are willing to go.
People need to start voting with their feet and stop paying hyperinflated prices so they have to cut the prices of these events.
The standard price of an A List concert now is minimum $200 for a ticket, it's getting absolutely absurd, especially with the cost of living as it is.
[brotherfranciz] This is Ticketmaster standard behaviour btw - Same happens with Rugby league and union - to the point that people now wait as they know it won't fill up.
This is nothing new. I remember paying for reduced tickets to watch Atletico Madrid vs Melbourne Victory in Geelong in 2016. I thought I got a good deal but then they offered free tickets a few days before the match…
[Skinnerr] I'm not exactly weeping for him bro when he afford to take the fam out for a cheeky $600 night out initially. Surge pricing is here to stay. I remember years ago when that was more than a week's rent.
[Frackingiscool] We have enough people every sport has a decent uptake. If you're involved in any of them you obviously see people who are into it.
Between my own kids, nieces, nephews, friends, family etc I have been amazed how many people are involved in lacrosse, water polo, dressage, archery, table tennis, badminton, volleyball, RC cars, slot car racing, gokarting, etc etc
Not to doubt soccer is popular but if that's what you're into, obviously that's what you see.
[QuickToThePointless] Hey Rita - bring the slot cars to Optus!
[Frackingiscool] I'd go watch. So would literally dozens of us.
[Webluce] I went to buy tickets for my family soon after they came out and was going to pay $100 each for seats really high up. Decided to leave it until a couple weeks before the game and managed to get really good seats for $39 each.
Agreed they overpriced them from the start
Besides the dedicated Italian football fans in Perth, you’re not going to fill a 60k seater stadium at exorbitant prices. If it were the top premier league or la liga teams, maybe you would. The crowd really got into it when modric came on
[CptnObvious] Why they dont get lazio here and instead bore us with these woke clubs
[toblerone21] https://c.files.bbci.co.uk/21D0/production/_109465680_195856…
[Almost Banned] If the weather were nicer I'd probably go.
[Fire Chicken] Should've come to the East Coast if they needed the sales
[Supercool] Rain expected to ease off at 7. These seats will cop it in the face.. can hang out in concourse area and drink expensive beers
[michaelTito] Meanwhile 80k people at the Chelsea spurs game in Sydney. Come to east coast next time
[Checkmate3023] i reckon if Alessandro Circati sign/s for Juva he would be able to sell out stadiums in Oz
Australia is 'cry out' for outfield players playing at top clubs in top leagues we legit have have so few and since the crop of 06
I reckon we would appericate these matches more if there was an Australian to 'get behind'
otherwise it is only the big Premier League sides and Real and FCB that can draw a crowd in Australia
[Snoop] Should've been in Melbourne.
You may have paid a hidden tax, driven over a pothole, or been slashed by a machete… but at least you'd be doing it with a decent crowd. 🤣
[Lovemybargains] Definitely should have been held in Melbourne. There will be more paying people at the west coast / Collingwood game in Perth on Sunday
[Duece1995] Why would they schedule this game in Perth?
Terrible. They are now forced to give away tickets.
Embarrassing.
[Duece1995] Melbourne or Sydney would sell out at full ticketed prices.
[Davo1111] If you look it's not that many tickets. It's the dregs in the back row.
Allows them to say it's a sold out stadium.
[CheapGit] Considering the amount of Italians that live here I'm surprised they didn't sell more tickets, then again people probably thought the teams would be mainly youth players and reserve players with it being a world cup year.
[michaelTito] Ah yes serie A teams resting their players who are mostly Italian for the World Cup.
[CheapGit] Well considering Italy never played at this years world cup but Milan still managed to have 10 first team players play, tells you everything about the squad and the majority of their squad are non Italian.
So quite understandable to think maybe all the first team players wouldn't be in Perth.
[michaelTito] Yes the mighty inter Milan in red and black
[CheapGit] @michaelTito: Well over half of Inters squad are also non Italian but im guessing they didnt have as many players at the world cup.
Had AC on my mind as been watching them to see if rigid Ruben sticks to his non changeable 343 😂
[supaconan] To be fair - the Inter - Milan game had notable names throughout the team.
It's only 3 weeks until the start of the season so they can't just play the reserves.
There were 52k people for that game - so turnout is good.
[CheapGit] With todays weather in Perth 52k will be a decent turn out!
[supaconan] A miracle! I doubt you'll get more than 30k
It's a toughie - do you play at HBF park and only get 20k people there - I mean Juventus Palermo is being played there.
For Juve - Inter you should be getting more than that
[Jiva] Says, "These Tickets Are No Longer Available".
[Supercool] Of taxpayers.. with tickets paid by the city?
[Frackingiscool] Of people catching a cold and won't be in Monday.
[jjjaar] Went to the map selection and picked a lone seat, added to cart no problem. Did this a couple of times.
My guess is the number of people “just seeing” if they can add it to cart means the seats listed at the top are continuously “unavailable”.
[chintu123] Does anyone know if this includes free transperth to/from stadium? Do you show ticketmaster tickets for train?
[mjjeje] Free public transport 3 hour before and after the event. You need to display tickets.
[freoleo] Yes and show if they ask but they probably won't ask
[churlish] Or be aboriginal and walk on free anytime.
[churlish] Got one. Looks like bad weather tonight, we'll see. Thankyou.
[Cheepcheepcheep] Would go if I had a ticket free public transport, don’t live too far from the traino.
[Drakesy] Between tossing up fictional crowd numbers at the wednesday game (there's no way 53,000 were at the ground). And paying taxpayer money to cashed up football clubs to come here it's a bit of a flop
[Cheepcheepcheep] To think that Serie A game almost happened earlier this year, least common sense prevailed from all parties.
[Pigey] Yeah 35,000 at best. You need to sell restricted views, and the banners of the tifo probably took up 10 bays.
Not many corporates either.
[j ck] Looking for four tickets if anyone has tickets they acquired and no longer want.
[Cheepcheepcheep] If only I was here earlier, the weather is bad but it’s winter. Inter for the win.
